p01.label: violation
p01.note: div + addEventListener('click'), no tabindex — the canonical defect

p10.label: violation
p10.note: tabindex=0 + click, no key handler — focusable, NOT actionable (KAFE sub-case 2)

p11.label: violation
p11.note: inline onclick= attribute, no tabindex — the only variant attribute scanners can see

p12.label: violation
p12.note: <a> with no href driving JS (KAFE: 34 instances in the wild)

p20.label: decoy
p20.note: class btn + cursor:pointer, no handler — lexical/CSS heuristic trap

p22.label: decoy
p22.note: click handler that produces no observable effect

p23.label: decoy
p23.note: clickable card — equivalent functionality reachable via the <a> it contains (Stage 4 dismissal)

p23a.label: ok
p23a.note: the real link inside the card

p25.label: ok
p25.note: label for a clip-hidden (still focusable) checkbox

p25i.label: ok
p25i.note: the clip-hidden checkbox — reachable by Tab, toggled by Space

p26.label: violation
p26.note: label for a display:none checkbox — mouse-only toggle

p27.label: decoy
p27.note: decorative span inside a real button — functionality is the button's

p30.label: violation
p30.note: menu that expands on pure CSS :hover — no JS, no DOM mutation

p31.label: violation
p31.note: menu that expands on a JS mouseover listener

p33.label: decoy
p33.note: hover tooltip on running text — not an operable control (SC 1.4.13, not 2.1.1)

p40.label: violation
p40.note: delegated listener on document — invisible to getEventListeners(el)

p42.label: ok
p42.note: real button served by the same delegated handler

p60.label: violation
p60.note: handler fires fetch() only — no DOM trace

p61.label: violation
p61.note: handler writes localStorage only — no DOM trace

p62.label: violation
p62.note: handler draws to canvas only — no DOM trace

p63.label: violation
p63.note: handler logs to console only — no DOM trace

p70.label: decoy
p70.note: covered by a transparent overlay — no user can operate it; element.click() fires it anyway

p80.label: ok
p80.note: button with tabindex=5 — in tab order, but reordered away from document order

p81.label: violation
p81.note: tabindex=-1 + click handler — focusable via .focus(), NOT in tab order

p82.label: excluded
p82.note: inside an inert container — blocked for mouse and keyboard alike

p84.label: ok
p84.note: plain button, first in document order

p86.label: ok
p86.note: plain button, last in document order

p90.label: violation
p90.note: clickable div inside an OPEN shadow root

p91.label: violation
p91.note: clickable div inside a CLOSED shadow root

p92.label: violation
p92.note: clickable div inside a same-origin iframe

p93.label: ok
p93.note: real button inside an OPEN shadow root

p50.label: violation
p50.note: React <div onClick> — handler is delegated to the root container

p54.label: violation
p54.note: React div tabIndex=0 with onClick only — focusable, not actionable

p55.label: decoy
p55.note: React div styled as a button with no onClick
